jit_access_enabled.title: JIT Access Provisioning Enabled
jit_access_enabled.description: Indicates whether just-in-time access provisioning is actively enabled in the PAM system, requiring on-demand elevation rather than standing privileged access.

max_session_duration_minutes.title: Maximum JIT Session Duration (Minutes)
max_session_duration_minutes.description: The maximum allowed duration in minutes for a JIT-elevated privileged session before automatic expiration. Lower values reduce exposure window.

standing_privileged_accounts_exist.title: Standing Privileged Accounts Exist
standing_privileged_accounts_exist.description: Indicates whether any accounts retain persistent (non-expiring) elevated privileges outside of the JIT provisioning workflow, undermining JIT protections.

session_recording_enabled.title: Privileged Session Recording Enabled
session_recording_enabled.description: Whether full session recording (keystrokes, commands, screen activity) is actively enabled for all privileged sessions, stored in a tamper-evident audit repository.

recording_scope.title: Recording Scope
recording_scope.description: Defines which privileged sessions are subject to recording — all sessions, only selected roles, or none.

tamper_evident_storage.title: Tamper-Evident Log Storage
tamper_evident_storage.description: Whether recorded session logs and audit data are stored in a tamper-evident manner (e.g., cryptographic hashing, write-once storage, WORM, or externally signed audit trail).

vault_enabled.title: Credential Vault Enabled
vault_enabled.description: Whether a privileged credential vault (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, CyberArk, AWS Secrets Manager) is actively in use to store privileged credentials in encrypted form.

rotation_policy.title: Credential Rotation Policy
rotation_policy.description: Whether automatic credential rotation is configured — either on a fixed schedule, immediately after each use (post-use), or both.

max_rotation_interval_days.title: Maximum Credential Rotation Interval (Days)
max_rotation_interval_days.description: The maximum number of days allowed between automatic credential rotations. A value of 0 indicates post-use (immediate) rotation only.

credential_types_covered.title: Credential Types Covered by Vault
credential_types_covered.description: List of privileged credential types enrolled in the vault and subject to rotation (e.g., 'password', 'ssh_key', 'api_key', 'service_account').

behavioral_baselining_enabled.title: Behavioral Baselining Enabled
behavioral_baselining_enabled.description: Whether the PAM solution continuously baselines normal privileged user behavior to establish a reference profile for anomaly detection.

alert_triggers_configured.title: Alert Triggers Configured
alert_triggers_configured.description: List of anomaly categories for which alerts are configured (e.g., unusual_access_time, atypical_resource_access, abnormal_command_sequence, geographic_anomaly, privilege_escalation).

alert_notification_destination.title: Alert Notification Destination
alert_notification_destination.description: The configured destination for behavioral anomaly alerts (e.g., SIEM, SOC ticketing system, email group, webhook endpoint).

mfa_enforcement_scope.title: MFA Enforcement Scope
mfa_enforcement_scope.description: Defines which privileged access attempts require MFA — none, some roles, all privileged roles, or all with continuous re-verification.

mfa_bypass_exceptions_exist.title: MFA Bypass Exceptions Exist
mfa_bypass_exceptions_exist.description: Indicates whether any service accounts, break-glass accounts, or privileged roles have documented MFA bypass exceptions or exclusions in policy.

mfa_method_strength.title: MFA Method Strength
mfa_method_strength.description: The strongest MFA method permitted for privileged access — phishing-resistant (FIDO2/hardware key), authenticator app (TOTP/push), SMS/voice, or none.

audit_logging_enabled.title: Privileged Session Audit Logging Enabled
audit_logging_enabled.description: Whether immutable audit logging is enabled for all privileged account authentications, authorization decisions, and actions taken within the PAM system.

log_immutability_mechanism.title: Log Immutability Mechanism
log_immutability_mechanism.description: The mechanism used to prevent tampering or deletion of privileged access audit logs after they are written.

log_retention_days.title: Audit Log Retention Period (Days)
log_retention_days.description: The number of days privileged access audit logs and session recordings are retained before expiration or deletion.

logged_event_types.title: Logged Privileged Event Types
logged_event_types.description: The types of privileged access events captured in the audit trail (e.g., authentication, authorization, command_execution, session_recording, privilege_escalation).

approval_workflow_enabled.title: Approval Workflow Enabled
approval_workflow_enabled.description: Indicates whether a structured request-and-approval workflow is enforced before granting privileged access, including JIT elevation requests.

minimum_approvers_required.title: Minimum Approvers Required
minimum_approvers_required.description: The minimum number of human approvers required before privileged access is granted.

approval_audit_logging_enabled.title: Approval Audit Logging Enabled
approval_audit_logging_enabled.description: Indicates whether approval decisions (approvals and denials) are recorded in an immutable audit log with approver identity and timestamp.

access_expiry_enforcement.title: Access Expiry Enforcement
access_expiry_enforcement.description: Whether approved privileged access is time-limited and automatically revoked after the approved window expires.

automated_session_termination_enabled.title: Automated Session Termination Enabled
automated_session_termination_enabled.description: Whether the PAM system is configured to automatically terminate privileged sessions upon detection of policy violations or anomalous behavior without requiring manual operator intervention.

session_termination_triggers.title: Configured Session Termination Triggers
session_termination_triggers.description: List of defined events or conditions that will trigger automatic or operator-assisted session termination (e.g., 'policy_violation', 'anomalous_command', 'idle_timeout', 'behavioral_anomaly', 'unauthorized_data_access').

operator_termination_capability.title: Operator-Triggered Session Termination Available
operator_termination_capability.description: Whether authorized operators (security analysts, SOC team) have a mechanism to manually terminate active privileged sessions in real time through the PAM platform or administrative console.

termination_audit_logging_enabled.title: Session Termination Audit Logging Enabled
termination_audit_logging_enabled.description: Whether all session termination events (automated or manual) are recorded in an audit log with details such as timestamp, actor, session ID, and reason for termination.

rbac_enabled.title: Role-Based Access Control Enabled
rbac_enabled.description: Indicates whether role-based access control (RBAC) is configured and enforced for privileged accounts, restricting permissions to defined roles rather than ad-hoc grants.

overprivileged_role_count.title: Count of Overprivileged Roles
overprivileged_role_count.description: The number of roles that have been identified as granting permissions beyond what is required for the function they serve (e.g., wildcard permissions, admin-level access on non-admin roles).

privilege_review_frequency.title: Privilege Review Frequency
privilege_review_frequency.description: How frequently privileged role assignments and permissions are reviewed and recertified to ensure continued alignment with least-privilege requirements.

siem_integration_enabled.title: SIEM Integration Enabled
siem_integration_enabled.description: Whether the PAM solution has an active integration configured to forward privileged access events to a SIEM platform.

event_forwarding_method.title: Event Forwarding Method
event_forwarding_method.description: The mechanism used to send privileged access events to the SIEM (e.g., syslog, API push, native connector, or none).

forwarded_event_types.title: Forwarded Event Types
forwarded_event_types.description: List of privileged access event categories being forwarded to the SIEM (e.g., session_start, session_end, credential_checkout, policy_violation, failed_auth).
